note: *fez conhecer* kept against the stylist's idiom *deu a conhecer*, because 76:15 renders the identical *Notam fecísti* as *Fizestes conhecer* (rule 6).
*abale-se o mar*, identical with 95:11 (same Greek σαλεύω); the blind reader heard troubled or damaged. *seja abalado* and *agite-se* are the options.
*baterão palmas* (D43) held twice against the Latinist, who wants the singular *manu* heard. *aplaudirão com a mão* is the option.
